scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --outfile=dist/app.js --target=browser --format=iife --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace --define 'process.env.NODE_ENV="production"' && bun build src/sw.ts --outfile=dist/sw.js --target=browser --format=iife --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace && bun run scripts/inline.mjs
scripts.dev: bun build src/main.ts --outfile=dist/app.js --target=browser --format=iife --watch & bun build src/sw.ts --outfile=dist/sw.js --target=browser --format=iife --watch & bun run scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.anchor.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mediator.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mail-plugin.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mls-ds.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mimi.json
scripts.test: for f in $(find test -name '*.test.ts' | sort); do echo "== $f"; bun test "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run knip && bun run test
